name: App shell
description: The frame of a web app: a sidebar beside a main area, each scrolling on its own. On phones the sidebar becomes a Bottom nav (recommended), a drawer or a sideways row. Settings reuse it inside a full-size Dialog.

classes.ayy-app-shell: Root. A viewport-high (100dvh) grid: sidebar column (15rem) and a main column. Neither column grows the page; each scrolls on its own. Sets position: relative (the drawer and its scrim are placed inside it). To embed the shell in a box with a fixed height, set block-size: 100% on it. Below 48rem its phone layout follows its children: a .ayy-bottom-nav child shows as the tab bar and the sidebar hides; a __bar makes the sidebar a drawer; with neither, the sidebar becomes a sideways row.
classes.ayy-app-shell__sidebar: The <aside>: surface background, hairline on its inline-end edge, brand at the top, nav below, footer pinned to the bottom. Scrolls vertically when its content is taller than the viewport. On phones it's hidden (bottom-nav layout) or a drawer, and keeps its full tree either way.
classes.ayy-app-shell__brand: Logo / product name link at the top of the sidebar.
classes.ayy-app-shell__nav: <nav> holding the links, stacked vertically (side by side in the phone row).
classes.ayy-app-shell__link: Destination link. aria-current="page" marks the page you're on: it gets a tint and a heavier weight.
classes.ayy-app-shell__group: A headed section of the nav: a __group-label over a __list. Groups after the first get a hairline above them.
classes.ayy-app-shell__group-label:
The group's heading: a small uppercase

. Give it an id and point the list's aria-labelledby at it.
classes.ayy-app-shell__list: The <ul> of a group. Each <li> holds a link, a link followed by a __sublist, or a __collapse.
classes.ayy-app-shell__sublist: A nested <ul> of child links, indented along a guide line. One level only. Follows a parent link, or sits inside a __collapse. Give it an aria-label when it follows a link.
classes.ayy-app-shell__collapse: A native <details> for a group of child links that opens and closes. Its <summary class="ayy-app-shell__link"> is the toggle, with a chevron at the inline end; put the links in a __sublist inside it. Add `open` when it holds the current page.
classes.ayy-app-shell__link--sub: Modifier for a child link inside a __sublist: a smaller control and a lighter weight.
classes.ayy-app-shell__footer: Pinned to the bottom of the sidebar (the end of the row on phones): settings, account, help link. Keep it short.
classes.ayy-app-shell__main: The <main> content column. Scrolls on its own and has the page gutter. In a settings dialog it's a <div>: the page behind already has the one <main>.
classes.ayy-app-shell__bar: Phone top bar, first child of the shell, hidden from 48rem: the brand, then one or two actions (search, account), which sit at the inline end. Add a __toggle to it when the sidebar should open as a drawer. With a bar or a bottom nav the phone sidebar is off-screen; it slides in from the inline-start edge over a scrim while a toggle has aria-expanded="true".
classes.ayy-app-shell--settings: Settings mode, on the root of a shell inside a <dialog class="ayy-dialog ayy-dialog--full">, which it fills; the dialog's close button is the way out. The sidebar holds an __title and a nav of settings sections (groups of links, one aria-current="page"); the main holds the open section, starting with a Top bar whose title names it and whose back button shows on phones only; the section's content sits in a column of --ayy-size-measure, centred; in the dialog the section title is larger. No __bar and no bottom nav. (On a page of its own instead of a dialog, start the sidebar with an __back.) Below 48rem: with no section link current the sidebar is the whole screen (a large title and rows with chevrons) and the main is hidden; with one current, the main is the screen and the sidebar is hidden.
classes.ayy-app-shell__back: Only for a settings shell on a page of its own (in a dialog, the close button is the way out). First in the sidebar: an <a href> back to the page settings were opened from (or a <button>), with a directional arrow icon and "Back to <app name>". In settings mode, Esc follows it.
classes.ayy-app-shell__head: The sidebar's top row for a collapsible sidebar: the __toggle first, then the __brand (and any actions). The toggle lines up with the link icons, so it stays put in the rail while the brand clips.
classes.ayy-app-shell__title: A settings sidebar's heading, an <h2> "Settings" that names the dialog (aria-labelledby). Large on the phone's section list.
classes.ayy-app-shell__toggle: The button that opens the sidebar as a drawer on phones: in the __bar (with ayy-button ayy-button--ghost ayy-button--icon and a menu icon), or as the "More" tab of the bottom nav (<button class="ayy-bottom-nav__link ayy-app-shell__toggle">). Its aria-expanded is the drawer's state. In the sidebar (first in an __head, with a directional sidebar icon and aria-label="Sidebar") it collapses and expands the sidebar on wide screens, and its aria-expanded is whether the sidebar is open. connectAppShell() / <ayy-app-shell> / React AppShell manage it.
classes.ayy-app-shell--collapsed: Collapsed sidebar mode on wide screens: the sidebar narrows to an icon rail, animating its width with the main column. Rows stay on one line and in place, so icons keep their spot while labels and group labels fade and clip (wrap a link's label in a <span> to fade it); links without an icon fade out and leave the tab order; sub-lists hide. The toggle's aria-expanded reflects the state.
classes.ayy-app-shell--hover-preview: With --collapsed: resting the pointer on the rail (after a short pause) or moving keyboard focus into it widens the sidebar to full width over the main area with the overlay shadow, without moving the main content; it closes a moment after the pointer leaves. A mouse click inside doesn't keep it open. Right after the sidebar's toggle collapses it, connectAppShell sets data-ayy-hold on the sidebar so it doesn't reopen under the pointer, until the pointer leaves or focus moves on.
classes.ayy-app-shell--drawer: Root modifier: below 48rem the sidebar is a drawer even with no __bar and no bottom nav (instead of the sideways row), and the __toggle may sit in the main area, in an app's own top bar. Wide screens are unchanged.
classes.ayy-app-shell__detail: A third column at the inline end (an <aside>), for what's picked in the main area: a task, a message. Surface background, hairline on its inline-start edge, scrolls on its own, --ayy-detail-w wide (22rem). Show and hide it with the hidden attribute: hidden, the shell is two columns again. Below 48rem it covers the screen, so start it with a Top bar and a back button.
classes.ayy-app-shell__resize: A drag handle on the sidebar's inline-end edge, a direct child of the shell with role="separator" aria-orientation="vertical" tabindex="0" (added for you). Dragging, the arrow keys (Shift for big steps), Home and End set --ayy-sidebar-w on the shell; a double click resets it. Limits come from aria-valuemin / aria-valuemax in px (default 192 and 384), and the main area always keeps 320px. Hidden below 48rem and while the sidebar is collapsed.
classes.ayy-app-shell__resize--detail: Modifier: the handle for the detail pane's inline-start edge, setting --ayy-detail-w (limits default 288 and 640). Shown only while the detail pane is.
classes.ayy-app-shell--resizing: Set by connectAppShell while a handle is being dragged: columns follow the pointer without animating. Don't set it yourself.
classes.ayy-app-shell--md: Medium size: 32px compact rows with 16px icons.
classes.ayy-app-shell--sm: Small size, for long navigation such as a docs tree: sm-height links with no gap between them, regular weight, sm icons and the control radius. Big (lg, no modifier) is the default for apps.

default.looks: A 15rem surface sidebar with a hairline at the inline end, and the main area on the page background; each scrolls on its own. Links are muted pills.

hover.when: .ayy-app-shell__link:hover; on a collapsed shell with hover preview, .ayy-app-shell__sidebar:hover expands the sidebar as an overlay
hover.looks: Link gets a wash fill and the text colour. In hover preview, the sidebar animates to its full width with the overlay shadow over the content.

focus.looks: Links and brand: 2px ring, 2px offset. A focused scroll area (sidebar or main with tabindex="0") gets the ring inset.

disabled.none: Sidebar links are never disabled: leave out pages the user can't open.

selected.looks: Current page: wash-hover fill, text colour, semibold (not colour alone). A closed collapse holding it shows its summary in text colour and semibold. Forced colours: Highlight. In settings mode the current section link is the open section; below 48rem it decides whether the section list or the section fills the screen.

error.none: Errors belong in the main content (Alert).

loading.none: The frame renders at once; show Skeletons in the main area while a screen loads.

open.when: __toggle[aria-expanded="true"] (below 48rem, with a __bar or a Bottom nav); <details open> for a collapse
open.looks: Phone: the sidebar slides in from the inline-start edge as a drawer (at most 18rem) over a scrim, with the overlay shadow. A collapse's chevron turns up.

scale.sm: Small: links at the sm control height (28px compact), sub-links sm, no gap between rows, regular weight, 16px icons, the control radius.
scale.md: Medium: links at the md control height (32px compact), sub-links sm, 16px icons.
scale.lg: Big (default): links at the lg control height (40px compact), sub-links md, --ayy-space-0-5 between rows, medium weight, 20px icons, pill radius.

sizes.density: Big links are at least the lg control height (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), Small ones sm (28, 36, 40); both with lg control text, sub-links one step down. Grows with data-density.
sizes.width: Fills the viewport (100dvh) or its box (block-size: 100%). Wide screens: 15rem sidebar or collapsed icon rail. Below 48rem: a top __bar, a Bottom nav and a drawer, or one scrolling row when it holds neither.

react.import: import { AppShell, AppShellBar, AppShellToggle, AppShellSidebar, AppShellBrand, AppShellNav, AppShellGroup, AppShellItem, AppShellLink, AppShellFooter, AppShellMain, AppShellBack, AppShellTitle, AppShellHead, BottomNav, BottomNavLink, BottomNavButton } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

AppShell.renders: <div class="ayy-app-shell">; wires the phone drawer when it holds an AppShellToggle (in the AppShellBar) or a BottomNavButton with className="ayy-app-shell__toggle"

props.size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" — Big (lg, default, for apps), Medium (md) or Small (sm, for long navigation such as a docs tree).
props.settings: boolean — settings mode (ayy-app-shell--settings), inside <DialogContent size="full">: the sidebar holds AppShellTitle and the sections.
props.collapsed: boolean — collapse the sidebar to an icon rail on wide screens (ayy-app-shell--collapsed).
props.hoverPreview: boolean, default true — when collapsed, hovering or focusing the sidebar expands it as an overlay preview (ayy-app-shell--hover-preview). false keeps the icon rail until the toggle opens it.
props.onCollapseChange: (collapsed: boolean) => void — called when the sidebar is collapsed or expanded via a toggle button.
props.drawer: boolean — below 48rem the sidebar is a drawer even without an AppShellBar or a BottomNav; the AppShellToggle may sit in the main area (ayy-app-shell--drawer).
props.onResize: (edge: "sidebar" | "detail", width: number | null) => void — a resize ended (drag or key); width in px, null when reset. Save it and start the next session with style={{ "--ayy-sidebar-w": `${width}px` }}.

AppShellBack.renders: <a class="ayy-app-shell__back" href> with a directional arrow and the children in a <span>; a <button type="button"> without href

props.href: string — where leaving settings goes. Without it, pass onClick.

props.children: An AppShellToggle (the collapse toggle, a sidebar icon), then the AppShellBrand.
"Settings". Give it an id and point the DialogContent's aria-labelledby at it.

AppShellCollapse.renders: <details class="ayy-app-shell__collapse"> with a link-styled <summary> and a <ul>

props.label: The toggle row: an icon and a short label.
props.open: Start open. Set it when the group holds the current page.

AppShellDetail.renders: <aside class="ayy-app-shell__detail"> — pass the hidden attribute to hide it; the shell goes back to two columns

AppShellResize.renders: <div class="ayy-app-shell__resize" role="separator" tabindex="0"> — a direct child of AppShell

props.aria-label: Defaults to "Resize sidebar" / "Resize detail pane" (translate it).

props.as: "main" | "div" — "div" in a settings dialog, so the page keeps one <main>. Default "main".

AppShellBar.renders: <header class="ayy-app-shell__bar"> — first child; brand, then actions

AppShellToggle.renders: <button class="ayy-button ayy-button--ghost ayy-button--icon ayy-app-shell__toggle"> with a menu icon

a11y: The sidebar is an <aside> (a complementary landmark) and the content is a <main>: one <main> per page, and no other element with that landmark.

Keep one <nav aria-label="Main"> in the sidebar. The bottom nav repeats its top destinations and only one of the two shows at a time, so it can use the same label. Give any other nav (a settings menu) its own label.

Mark the current page with aria-current="page" in both the sidebar and the bottom nav. The link also gets a tint and a heavier weight, so colour is not the only cue; High Contrast mode fills it with the system highlight.
Put a .ayy-skip-link before the shell, pointing at an id on <main>, so keyboard users can jump past the sidebar.

Group with a heading and a list: the

label names the

    through aria-labelledby, so a screen reader announces "Workspace, list, 3 items".
A collapse is a native <details>: Enter and Space toggle it, and the open state is exposed for you. Don't add aria-expanded to the <summary>.
Mark the current child with aria-current="page" and open its collapse. A closed collapse that holds the current page is drawn bolder, so the location isn't hidden.
Both columns are scroll containers. If a column can scroll but holds nothing focusable, give it tabindex="0" so keyboard users can scroll it.

The drawer's toggle is a real <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the sidebar (set for you). Opening moves focus to the first link in the drawer and makes the rest of the shell inert; Esc closes it and returns focus to the toggle.

Settings mode: name the dialog by the sidebar title (aria-labelledby on the <dialog>), give the sections' nav its own label ("Settings"), mark the open section with aria-current="page", and make the section's Top bar title its <h1> (the sidebar title is an <h2>). Render the main as a <div> so the page keeps one <main>. On phones, opening a section moves focus to the main, and its back button returns it to the section's link.

A collapsed sidebar with hover preview opens when keyboard focus moves into it (:focus-visible), so every link is reachable and readable from the keyboard; links without an icon are only in the tab order while it's open. Give rail links a title for a tooltip with the pointer.

In a dialog, Esc closes settings and focus returns to what opened them. A settings shell on a page of its own leaves through its __back on Esc, except when focus is in a text field or an open menu, popover or dialog has it.
A resize handle is a separator you can focus: arrow keys move the edge by 16px (Shift 64), Home and End jump to the limits, and aria-valuenow / min / max are kept in px.
The detail pane is an <aside>: label it (aria-label) for what it shows, and move focus into it when you open it from the main area.
The phone sidebar (closed drawer) is visibility: hidden, and the bottom nav is display: none from 48rem, so hidden links are out of the tab order and the accessibility tree.
do: Use it as the outer layout of a signed-in app or dashboard.
Keep the same destinations, icons and order on every screen.
Use size="sm" for long navigation such as a docs tree.
With more than five destinations, put the four most used in the bottom nav and end with a "More" tab that opens the drawer.
Group destinations under headings once there are more than about six.
Keep each link to one line: an icon and a short label. Put account and help in the footer.
Start each page in the main with a Page header.
Add a __resize handle when people have long names to read, and save the width from onResize / ayy-resize.
Open settings in a Dialog with size="full", sections grouped, each starting with a Top bar.
dont: Don't use it for a marketing site (use Navbar) or to switch views of one object (use Tabs).
Don't put a Navbar in it or nest a second app shell.
Don't nest links deeper than one level.
Don't rely on the sideways row for a real app: it hides links. Use a bottom nav, a __bar, or the --drawer modifier.
Don't make the detail pane the only place to do something: on phones it covers the screen, so give it a back button.
Don't show or hide the sidebar with your own media queries; the shell switches at 48rem.
Don't scroll the page body as well, or cap the main width.
Don't put settings in Tabs or a small Dialog.

attributes.size: "md" | "sm" — Big (default) or Small (sets ayy-app-shell--sm). Leave it out to keep a hand-written ayy-app-shell--sm.
attributes.collapsed: boolean — collapse the sidebar to an icon rail on wide screens (sets ayy-app-shell--collapsed).
attributes.hover-preview: On by default: when collapsed, hovering or focusing the sidebar expands it as an overlay preview (sets ayy-app-shell--hover-preview). hover-preview="false" keeps the icon rail until the toggle opens it.

events.ayy-collapse-change: { collapsed: boolean } — fired when the sidebar is collapsed or expanded via a toggle button or the collapsed property.
events.ayy-resize: { edge: "sidebar" | "detail", width: number | null } — fired when a resize handle's drag or key press ends; width in px, null when reset to the default.

element.children: A <div class="ayy-app-shell">. Wires the phone drawer when the shell has a __toggle in its __bar or its .ayy-bottom-nav: the toggle opens and closes the sidebar; Esc, the scrim, a link in the drawer or widening past 48rem close it. On wide screens, wires sidebar collapsing and optional hover-preview. On a settings shell, Esc follows the __back.
